Once upon a time, in a small town, there was a clockmaker named Mr. Octavia. He was known for his exceptional craftsmanship and his ability to repair any broken clock. One day, while he was working on a broken Seiko watch, he stumbled upon an old wooden box. The box had no label or markings, but it had a strange pattern etched into the lid. Curious, Octavia decided to open the box and what he found inside was a hidden door.
The sea is salty because of the water cycle. Water evaporates from the ocean and condenses into clouds. When it rains, the water falls back into the ocean, making it saltier.
